sections.title: 🎯 What You'll Learn
sections.content:
Let's dive into how to create your own blueprints for objects in programming! Think of classes as cookie cutters that shape your data.

• How to define a class with properties and behaviors
• The basic structure of a class definition
• How to turn classes into usable objects

steps.title: Use the Objects

sections.title: ⚡ Key Points
points: ✓ A class is a blueprint for creating objects
✓ Use `class ClassName { }` to define a class
✓ Fields store object state, methods define actions
✓ Objects are created from classes using `new`

sections.title: 🔥 Tips & Mistakes
dos: Start with simple classes to understand the structure
Keep related properties and methods together
donts: Don't put everything in one class - keep them focused
Don't forget the class keyword when defining
Don't confuse class definition with object creation
sections.protip: Think of classes like recipes - they describe how to make something, but aren't the thing itself until you create it!

sections.title: 🌍 Real World Use
sections.content: Where is Defining Classes for Objects used in real apps?

examples.how: User classes store profile info and methods for posting, liking, etc.
Account classes track balances and handle deposits/withdrawals
Character classes define player attributes and actions

problem.description:
Create a `Book` class that represents a book in a library. It should have:
- Title (String)
- Author (String)
- Pages (int)
- A method `displayInfo()` that prints all book details
hints: Start by declaring the fields inside the class
The method should print each field with descriptive text
problem.explanation: We defined three fields to store book information and a method that prints them in a readable format. This creates a reusable blueprint for book objects!

sections.title: 📝 Summary
points: 📌 Classes are blueprints for creating objects
📌 Practice defining simple classes to master the structure
📌 You're now ready to create your own object blueprints!
